author: Dimitri “Diti” Torterat
annotationBasis: Parent-authorized loader admission of PROVISIONAL assistant dense static-frame annotations only. Reviewed literal is offline runner eligibility, not human ground truth or independently verified normality.
annotationMethod: Fresh sequential FFmpeg showinfo PTS; sequential OpenCV frame-index crosswalk. All consecutive frames from latest PTS <= window start through first PTS >= window end, inclusive. Boundary frames may provide context outside the exact window. 48 chronological frames per sheet, row-major, aspect-preserved 320x180 cells, caption source PTS ms and frame index. No subsampling. All 147 sheets were actually inspected through view_image at original sheet resolution, in chronological order. Each cell is aspect-preserved within 320x180 pixels; portrait imagery is consequently smaller. Every covering decoded frame was included, without temporal subsampling. This is static visual inspection, not real-time playback.
